name: Ray Marching with Differential Diffusion
aliases: Differentiable Ray Marching with Gradient Recording
Ray Marching for Rendering and Gradient Accumulation
definition: A ray marching algorithm that computes final radiance Lout and its derivative ∂πLout at a view point x by summing contributions from multiple scattering (Lms), single scattering (Lss), and radiative transfer (Lri), utilizing pre-computed intermediate variables stored as voxels.
